description:
Four entry types render incorrectly compared to upstream.

## 1. toolResult — format from toolCallMap

Elixir (entry_display_text in coder/components/tree_selector.ex):
Shows: `[read]`, `[bash]` — just the tool name.

Upstream builds a toolCallMap during flattenTree by scanning assistant message content for toolCall blocks.
When rendering a toolResult, it looks up the call by toolCallId and uses formatToolCall(name, args):
- read  → [read: ~/path/to/file] (with optional :offset-limit range)
- write → [write: ~/path]
- edit  → [edit: ~/path]
- bash  → [bash: command...] (first 50 chars)
- grep  → [grep: /pattern/ in ~/path]
- find  → [find: pattern in ~/path]
- ls    → [ls: ~/path]
- other → [name: {jsonArgs...}]
Paths are shortened: home dir replaced with ~.

Fix: Build a tool_call_map during flatten/2 in OctoPi.Coder.Components.TreeSelector (scan assistant
message content blocks for type "toolCall" entries). Pass it to render_lines/2 via opts or embed
in FlatNode. Upstream refs: flattenTree() lines 118-220, formatToolCall() lines 820-880 in
tree-selector.ts.

## 2. Compaction — use tokensBefore

Elixir: "compaction: #{summary truncated to 40}"
Upstream: theme.fg("borderAccent", "[compaction: #{round(tokensBefore/1000)}k tokens]")

Format: [compaction: Nk tokens], styled borderAccent, using tokensBefore not summary.
Entry.Compaction already has :tokens_before. Fix: use round(tokens_before / 1000).

## 3. session_info — show title name

Elixir: "session info" (no name)
Upstream: "[title: name]" or "[title: empty(italic)]" using theme.fg("dim") + theme.italic for empty.

Check Entry.SessionInfo for :name field. Format: [title: name] or [title: (empty)].

## 4. CustomMessage — missing renderer

Elixir: falls through to catch-all "[entry]" — no entry_display_text clause for Entry.CustomMessage.
Upstream: theme.fg("customMessageLabel", "[#{customType}]: ") + normalize(content)

Entry.CustomMessage has :custom_type and :content (String.t | [map()]). Add matching clause.

## Where to fix
apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/components/tree_selector.ex — entry_display_text/1 and flatten/2.

## Upstream references
- getEntryDisplayText() lines 690-790 in tree-selector.ts
- formatToolCall() lines 820-880 in tree-selector.ts
- flattenTree() lines 118-220 (toolCallMap population) in tree-selector.ts

## Verification
Open /tree with sessions containing tool calls, compaction entries, session name, and custom message
entries. Confirm each type renders with the correct format and colors.
title: /tree entry content format deviations (toolResult, Compaction, session_info, CustomMessage)
